name: 1. Electrical Cable Mapping
description: Demonstrates high-precision NLP entity extraction, dense vector retrieval, and ground-truth mapping for standard electrical cables.
query: Procurement of 1.5 sq mm single core PVC insulated flame retardant copper electrical cables suitable for internal building wiring.
expected_behavior: Returns IS 694 with high relevance score, QCO mandatory certification flag, and verified BIS evidence provenance.

name: 2. Ambiguous Requirement Guardrail
description: Demonstrates system safety guardrail detecting underspecified procurement descriptions and prompting user clarification.
query: Requirement for electrical cable for office project.
expected_behavior: Triggers NEEDS_CLARIFICATION status and prompts missing fields (product_type, voltage_grade, conductor_material).

name: 3. Multi-Attribute Civil Construction
description: Demonstrates multi-attribute feature scoring and Knowledge Graph traversal across materials and normative references.
query: Ready mixed concrete (RMC) grade M30 using Ordinary Portland Cement 43 Grade and coarse aggregates for structural RCC slab.
expected_behavior: Returns IS 4926 with related standards IS 456, IS 8112, and IS 383 referenced in Knowledge Graph.

name: 4. QCO Mandatory Certified Product
description: Demonstrates Quality Control Order (QCO) gazette compliance verification and clause-level reference.
query: Supply of outdoor 500 kVA 11kV/0.415kV oil immersed distribution transformer with Energy Efficiency Level 2.
expected_behavior: Returns IS 1180:Part 1 with QCO mandatory status and Ministry of Power Gazette citation.

name: 5. Out-of-Domain Safety Rejection
description: Demonstrates strict domain boundary enforcement and isolation against non-procurement or out-of-scope requests.
query: What is the best smartphone for gaming and how to write a Python fibonacci function?
expected_behavior: Triggers OUT_OF_DOMAIN status and rejects request without returning random standards.
